A wicked sound - a metallurgist's dream. Electro-Harmonix (2006-2008) The classic Metal Muff, housed in a smaller die-cast enclosure with simplified controls. 15dB boost and cut around a carefully selected mid frequency guarantees huge scoop gains. Switch selectable top boost ranges. A wicked sound. A metallurgist's dream.
